foundations.title: Purpose
foundations.text: To ensure every senior citizen experiences safe, dignified, and effortless mandir visits-while giving families quiet reassurance without taking away independence.

foundations.title: Vision
foundations.text: A world where seniors can access spiritual spaces with comfort, confidence, and companionship.

foundations.title: Mission
foundations.text: To deliver human-centered, culturally grounded support through simple digital touchpoints and on-ground assistance-making every mandir journey peaceful from planning to darshan to returning home.

promise: A peaceful mandir experience, supported with dignity.
positioning: For senior citizens who seek a safe and smooth mandir experience, Saarthi is a guided spiritual companion service that uses familiar technology and human support to ensure comfort, confidence, and independence throughout their darshan journey.

values.name: Seva (Service)
values.text: Compassionate, devotional care at every touchpoint.

values.name: Simplicity
values.text: No new apps or friction—familiar, friendly interfaces like WhatsApp.

values.name: Safety
values.text: Reliable guidance, volunteers, checkpoints, and medical readiness.

values.name: Companionship
values.text: Subtle support from volunteers, fellow devotees, and family.

values.name: Trust
values.text: Transparent, predictable, reliable assistance throughout the experience.

personality.name: Warm
personality.text: Emotionally comforting, like a reassuring family member.

personality.name: Respectful
personality.text: Honors senior citizens’ autonomy and spiritual routine.

personality.name: Devotional
personality.text: Rooted in temple culture and tradition, without being preachy.

interfaces.name: Seniors
interfaces.intro: WhatsApp stays the primary senior interface: familiar, simple, no learning curve, low anxiety. Senior Mode is for digitally savvy seniors.
interfaces.principle: BIG fonts. HIGH contrast. ZERO complexity.

interfaces.name: Families
interfaces.intro: A stronger, richer family app flow that stays respectful and non-intrusive.
features: See planned mandir visits (only if senior opts in)
“Peace check”: A subtle “Everything okay” confirm from Saarthi
Senior preferences setup (only if given permission)

interfaces.name: Volunteers
interfaces.intro: An on-ground coordination interface for volunteers supporting the mandir experience.

interfaces.name: Temple Management
interfaces.intro: The admin layer for temple authorities, connecting service planning with daily operations.
interfaces.principle: A coordinated service behind every visit.

colors.name: Soft Pink
colors.reason: Warm, comforting, and emotionally gentle—ideal for elderly users who need reassurance and calm. Pink evokes care, empathy, and compassion, aligning with Saarthi’s purpose of guiding and supporting devotees. Soft shades reduce visual stress and feel inviting, not intimidating.
colors.meaning: Represents human connection, kindness, and emotional support. Positions Saarthi as a caring companion, not a formal authority.

colors.name: Deep Temple Brown
colors.reason: Inspired by temple woodwork, diyas, sacred soil, and traditional architecture. Conveys strength, stability, and trust, giving the brand a grounded, spiritual presence. An anchor for typography and key UI elements.
colors.meaning: Symbolizes devotion, rootedness, and cultural authenticity. Connects the service visually to Indian sacred spaces, making devotees feel familiar and comfortable.

colors.name: Soft Off-White
colors.reason: A clean, pure, minimal shade representing spiritual clarity, peace, and simplicity. A soothing, high-contrast background without the harshness of pure white. Elder-friendly: high readability, low glare.
colors.meaning: Reflects purity, serenity, and calmness, mirroring worship and darshan. A gentle canvas for information that improves accessibility for older devotees.

lines: सम्मान और सुविधा का विश्वसनीय साथ।
